verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a Neural Engine plus official developer runtimes/SDKs (Core ML/Metal ML APIs, MLX array framework, GPU Neural Accelerators) that ship today, supporting on-device AI acceleration. However, none of the evidence provides a published TOPS figure for the Neural Engine with a stated precision, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: a published TOPS number with precision (e.g., INT8/FP16) for the M4 Max Neural Engine, and independent verification of that figure.
